policy.ssot_rule: Reuse canonical Genesis modules for world, renderer, assets, physics, editor, runtime and build. Do not introduce parallel implementations.
policy.evidence_rule: Do not mark functionality VERIFIED without source-level mapping and reproducible tests or runtime evidence. CI green alone is insufficient.

existing_evidence.responsibility: Bounds checks and distance calculations; chunk registry; deterministic nearest-first selection; asset-presence gate; chunk loading state transitions.
existing_evidence.evidence_limit: Does not prove terrain generation, biome simulation, persistence, editor UI, collision integration, mesh generation or rendered pixels.

component_contracts.responsibility: Validated world/chunk coordinate model; stable IDs; finite numeric inputs; explicit coordinate units and origin policy.
missing_evidence: Reject NaN/infinity bounds and query positions
Document coordinate handedness, units and origin/rebase policy
Property tests for boundaries and distance calculations

component_contracts.responsibility: Deterministic chunk selection, budgeted load/unload, cancellation, stale completion handling and asset availability.
missing_evidence: Audit transition invariants and race/stale completion behavior
Stress tests for large worlds and bounded work

component_contracts.responsibility: Versioned terrain representation; seeded heightfields; deterministic noise composition; erosion as an optional explicit pass.
missing_evidence: Canonical symbols and file ownership not yet inventoried
Numerical bounds and deterministic cross-platform tests

component_contracts.responsibility: Convert terrain data into renderer-ready mesh assets; LOD selection, stitching and seam prevention.
Deterministic biome classification from configured climate/elevation/moisture fields; versioned rules and material mapping.
missing_evidence: No dependency on remote generation services

component_contracts.responsibility: Seeded placement, density masks, slope/elevation constraints, stable IDs and chunk-boundary consistency.
missing_evidence: Placement algorithm and stable seed derivation

component_contracts.responsibility: Terrain sculpt/flatten/smooth, paint, place/delete, grid/free placement, selection and undo/redo through canonical editor document.
missing_evidence: Inspect full editor module and UI wiring
Transactional edit model and undo/redo for terrain data

component_contracts.responsibility: Composable world objects, placement constraints, roads/path splines, building modules and region/streaming ownership.
missing_evidence: Determine existing prefab/scene contracts before adding types

component_contracts.responsibility: Water bodies, terrain intersection policy, shoreline metadata and renderer-independent water data.
Versioned world manifests, deterministic regeneration metadata, asset references, integrity hashes and migration policy.
missing_evidence: World serialization format and schema versioning
Cryptographic hash choice for integrity evidence

component_contracts.responsibility: Schedule generation and streaming within explicit CPU/memory budgets; avoid blocking frame-critical execution.
Terrain collision representation and lifecycle synchronization with world chunks and authored objects.
Unit/property/regression tests; deterministic seed fixtures; performance budgets; exact build/test artifact evidence.
missing_evidence: Execute tests against exact candidate SHA
Record run/job/step/exit code and artifact digests

next_actions: Inspect all relevant source files, tests and call sites in the canonical world/editor/renderer/assets/physics/runtime modules.
Expand path-to-symbol-to-test mapping; classify every function as MAPPED, EXCLUDED or UNRESOLVED with rationale.
Resolve existing chunk transition semantics and validate finite bounds and positions before terrain work.
Implement in small PRs starting with world coordinate/data contracts and deterministic terrain generation.
Add deterministic tests before marking each feature VERIFIED; do not claim build or CI evidence until captured.
